name: email
description: Email: read any folder, search, send, reply, reply-all, forward, drafts, spam, archive & trash via IMAP/SMTP, whitelisted contacts, and an Email page of your own
author: sapphire

app.label: Email
app.description: Your mail: inbox, sent, drafts, archive, spam and trash. Read, reply, move and send.

event_sources.name: email_message
event_sources.label: New Email
event_sources.description: New unread email received on an account

task_fields.label: Email Account
task_fields.help: Which email account this daemon monitors. Only this account will be polled.

task_fields.label: Auto-reply to sender
task_fields.help: ON (default): the AI's answer is emailed back to the sender, when the sender is in People with 'Allow email' ticked (Settings > Plugins > Email can open that to anyone). The AI can answer <<PASS>> to send nothing for a mail; say so in the task's prompt. OFF: the task still runs on incoming mail and nothing is sent by itself. A reply she sends with her email tools in that run follows the same rules: the sender only, and only people with that tick.

settings.label: Poll Interval (seconds)
settings.help: How often to check for new emails. Minimum 30 seconds.

settings.label: Allow sending to any address
settings.help: WARNING: When enabled, the AI can email anyone — not just whitelisted contacts. It can use recipient IDs from People OR type an email address directly. Use with caution.

confirm.title: Allow Unrestricted Email
warnings: The AI will be able to email ANY address — not just whitelisted contacts
This bypasses the People whitelist safety net entirely

settings.label: Allow reply-all
settings.help: ON (default): a reply can go to everyone on the email. Those people are already on the thread, so this does not use the contact whitelist. OFF: replies go to the sender only.

settings.label: Remember mail lists on this machine
settings.help: Lets the Email page open at once. Keeps who each mail is from, its subject, date and flags in a file on this machine, never the mail itself. Turning it off deletes what was kept, at once.

settings.label: Auto-reply to anyone
settings.help: Off (default): a reply sent while nobody is watching (a new-email task's automatic reply, or her own send_email in that task's run) only goes to people in People with 'Allow email' ticked. On: it answers anyone who writes in. Either way never automated mail, never the same mail twice, at most 10 a day per sender and 30 an hour per account.
